name: Abyss World 🕳️🌍[DEPTHS UPDATE]
desc:
I've found you.
You wish to undo the past. I am your means.
Atop the mountain sits the entrance of the trial: a windy and deserted town.
It's a dangerous and long journey to the bottom.
I will be waiting.
I hope you're a good jumper.

Warning: This game has a lives system in the main mode. Losing all lives means losing MOST progress. There are ways to permanently unlock things.

[THIS GAME IS IN BETA. EXPECT CHANGES IN FUTURE UPDATES DEPENDING ON FEEDBACK]
